title: Partitioning Operators
description: Learn to split collections into parts using Skip, SkipWhile, Take, and TakeWhile.
longDescription: This module covers the partitioning operators in LINQ. You'll learn to skip elements, take elements, and use conditional partitioning with SkipWhile and TakeWhile.
whatYouLearn: Skip elements with Skip and SkipWhile
Take elements with Take and TakeWhile
